# Vitalize

Vitalize is a Hospitals and Health Care company. Vitalize is an AI platform that unifies staffing, scheduling, flow, and capacity to replace reactivity with proactive, optimized operations. Vitalize employs 65 people (+109.7% YoY, +34 people), founded in 2021. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Brazil, Nigeria, and Pakistan.

## About

Our Mission: Unlock Healthcare's Full Capacity

Hospitals still run their most important operations—staffing, labor planning, and capacity—on paper, spreadsheets, and guesswork. The result: thousands of wasted hours, millions in unnecessary labor spend, and frontline teams stretched thin.

Vitalize replaces this with intelligent, automated staffing operations to align labor supply with patient demand. Our platform gives clinical leaders real-time decision support to reduce manual work, lower labor costs, and unlock patient capacity across the enterprise.

We are trusted by top health systems across the country, and have raised > $30M from top healthcare and technology investors.

## About

Jouw eerste stap naar een vitaal leven met supplementen van Vitalize
